props.gloss_en: Rav Pappa: 'whatever is fit to store' comes to exclude menstrual blood
Mar Ukva: 'whatever is fit to store' comes to exclude the wood of an ashera
the stam, for Mar Ukva: but menstrual blood -- one stores it for the cat
the stam, for Rav Pappa: since it weakens, one does not store it
R' Yosei bar Chanina: this [clause of the mishna] is not in accordance with R' Shimon
R' Shimon: they stated all these measures only for those who store them

supports.gloss_en: דאי כרבי שמעון, האמר: לא אמרו כל השיעורין הללו אלא למצניעיהן -- for R' Shimon the measures bind only those who store such items, whereas the mishna makes anyone carrying out a storable item liable

objections.gloss_en: ואידך? -- and the other [Rav Pappa]: is menstrual blood not stored for the cat?
